definitions.gloss: not applicable; not relevant; does not fall under (a category)
definitions.explanation: A checkbox or dropdown label meaning that a given item, rule, or category does not apply to the person or case in question. Common on government forms, applications, and legal documents as the opposite of {該当|がいとう} (applicable).

examples.japanese: {不該当|ふがいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧○⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧・{不該当|ふがいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いずれか→いずれか：22057_izureka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不該当|ふがいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧です。
examples.english: If this item is not applicable, you may leave it blank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対象品目|たいしょうひんもく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}する→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{不該当|ふがいとう}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Determine in advance whether the goods are applicable or not applicable to export controls.

notes:
Composed of the negative prefix {不|ふ} (non-) and ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧ (applicability; falling under). Pronounced ふがいとう, not ふがいとう with a nasal — treat it as a simple compound.

USAGE:
A bureaucratic form-filling word. You will see it printed next to a checkbox or as a dropdown option on application forms, visa paperwork, tax forms, export-control documents, and insurance forms. In casual speech, people say ⟦{当|あ}てはまらない→当てはまる：10212_atehamaru⟧ or ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ instead. The word itself is rarely used as a predicate in free prose; when it is, it takes だ or ⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不該当|ふがいとう}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧ ("this item is not applicable").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧・{不該当|ふがいとう}: applicable / not applicable (as paired options)
- {不該当|ふがいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧○⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to circle "not applicable"
- {不該当|ふがいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: if not applicable
- {不該当|ふがいとう}⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧: determination of non-applicability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧: applicable; falling under — the positive counterpart
- ⟦{非該当|ひがいとう}→非該当：29788_higaitou⟧: not falling under — a near-synonym, more common in export-control contexts
- ⟦{対象外|たいしょうがい}→対象外：10019_taishougai⟧: outside the scope; excluded — focuses on being outside the target set, not on whether a rule applies
